name: Silhouette-based Camera-to-Object Registration
definition: A method to retrieve a CAD model from a library and register relative camera extrinsics to its canonical frame by matching segmented object silhouettes against rendered CAD silhouettes.
summary: Silhouette-based Camera-to-Object Registration initializes camera poses by matching segmented object silhouettes against pre-rendered CAD silhouettes, using multi-view consensus to retain mutually consistent proposals without per-object pre-training.
